title: Native Recovery Retry Hardening: partial enrichment gets a second chance

claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.108 UX audit proved the raw PPTX visual-note blocker was gone in real output and raised the package to 98/A with no P0 findings.
The same audit stayed blocked because native Pass B recovery left lesson 1 on template fallback after a 548-character repair response.
Native Pass B recovery prompts now require strict JSON, complete kernel atoms, and native authoring fields for the missing lesson ids.
Native Pass B recovery no longer stops after the first no-progress retry when a second reserved recovery call is still available.
The release explicitly does not claim strict-clean provider output until a fresh deployed v0.15.109 ZIP/log audit proves full enrichment coverage and clean readiness.

carryForward: Fresh deployed v0.15.109 ZIP/log audit must verify full enrichment coverage and no readiness blocker.
Texture remains below strict-clean in the v0.15.108 audit.
Genome linkage remains 0/12 and still needs concept/source backbone work outside this recovery slice.
